mentions.name: San Francisco Sunset Alerts
mentions.description: This app sends alerts when a San Francisco sunset is predicted to be particularly outstanding and displays the prediction on a page alongside live views from several cameras around the city. Predictions are LLM-powered to more reliably consume the free-text descriptions of predicted high and low cloud cover around sunset in traditional weather forecasts (e.g., NWS).
mentions.problem: Traditional weather forecasts describe predicted cloud cover in free text, which is hard to consume reliably; LLM-based parsing makes the outstanding-sunset prediction possible.
mentions.source_excerpt: Over the past few weeks, I cobbled together a system of alerts for when the sunset is predicted [1] to be particularly outstanding, resulting in this page that displays the prediction and also shows the current view from several cameras around the city.
